hero.headline: BUILDING INFORMATION MODELING (BIM)
hero.title: Reliable. Scalable. Fast. Powerful.
hero.description: Illuminate your energy future—our drone-powered solar panel surveys deliver unmatched precision, faster insights, and smarter decisions from the sky down. By capturing high-resolution imagery, 3D terrain data, and thermal analytics, we help optimize solar performance while reducing costly on-site inspections.

whatIsBim.headline: What is BIM?
whatIsBim.description: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is a digital representation of the physical and functional characteristics of a facility. SmartGrid Surveying integrates high-precision survey data into BIM workflows, enabling better collaboration, clash detection, and lifecycle management for construction and infrastructure projects.

bimServices.headline: Our BIM Services
bimServices.description: We provide comprehensive BIM services tailored to the needs of architects, engineers, contractors, and facility managers.

items.title: 3D Laser Scanning & Point Clouds
items.description: Capture existing conditions with high-density point cloud data for accurate BIM model creation.

items.title: Digital Twin Creation
items.description: Build and update digital twins of assets for real-time monitoring and management.

items.title: BIM Model Integration
items.description: Seamlessly integrate survey data with design models in platforms like Revit, Navisworks, and ArchiCAD.

items.title: Clash Detection & Coordination
items.description: Identify and resolve design conflicts between structural, MEP, and architectural elements.

items.title: As-Built BIM Models
items.description: Create as-built models that reflect actual construction for operations and maintenance (O&M).

keyBenefits.headline: Why BIM Matters for Your Project

items.title: Improved Collaboration
items.description: Centralized data model enhances communication among all project stakeholders.

items.title: Time & Cost Savings
items.description: Reduce costly rework and delays by visualizing and validating designs before construction.

items.title: Risk Mitigation
items.description: Identify potential issues early in the design phase, reducing on-site surprises.

items.title: Lifecycle Management
items.description: Use the BIM model for efficient facility management, renovations, and future expansions.
